metadata.title: web3-ai — Pay-Per-Use AI Inference
metadata.description: AI inference powered by micropayments. No subscriptions, no API keys. Connect your wallet and pay only for what you use.

hero.title:
Pay-Per-Use AI.
No Subscriptions. No API Keys.
hero.subtitle: Connect your Web3 wallet, send a micropayment in USDC, and get AI inference results instantly. Powered by x402 — the open standard for internet-native payments.

howItWorks.title: How it Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps from wallet to AI results.

steps.title: Connect Wallet
steps.description: Link your Web3 wallet in one click. No sign-ups, no accounts — your wallet is your identity.

steps.title: Choose a Model
steps.description: Pick the AI model that fits your task — GPT, Claude, open-source models, and more.

steps.title: Pay & Receive
steps.description: A USDC micropayment settles instantly on Base L2. Get your inference result in the same response.

features.title: Why web3-ai?
features.subtitle: AI inference should be open, affordable, and verifiable.

items.title: Micropayments
items.description: Pay fractions of a cent per request. No minimums, no monthly fees, no wasted credits.

items.title: No API Keys
items.description: Your wallet is your identity. No sign-ups, no dashboards, no rate-limit emails.

items.title: Multi-Model
items.description: Access GPT, Claude, and open-source models through a single unified API.

items.title: On-Chain Verification
items.description: Every payment is recorded on-chain. Fully transparent and auditable by anyone.

items.title: Open Standard
items.description: Built on the x402 protocol — no vendor lock-in, works with any compliant provider.

items.title: Base L2
items.description: Transactions settle on Base for sub-cent gas fees and near-instant finality.

cta.title: Ready to Try Pay-Per-Use AI?
cta.subtitle: Connect your wallet and start making AI requests in seconds. No commitments, no subscriptions — just pay for what you use.
